similar_papers.title: A small interfering RNA screen for modulators of tumor cell motility identifies MAP4K4 as a promigratory kinase
differences: 摘要侧重于siRNA文库筛选与384孔板划痕实验的结合，提供高通量鉴定流程，但未详述单候选基因的上下游通路验证或挽救实验设计。

Here, we describe a genomic screen designed to identify inhibitors of cell migration. A library of 10,996 small interfering RNAs (targeting 5,234 human genes) was screened for their ability to block the migration of a highly motile ovarian carcinoma cell line, SKOV-3, by using a 384-well wound-healing assay coupled with automated microscopy and wound quantification. Two or more small interfering RNAs against four genes, CDK7, DYRK1B, MAP4K4 (NIK/HGK) (MAP4K4, mitogen-activated protein 4 kinase 4), and SCCA-1 (SerpinB3), potently blocked the migration of SKOV-3 cells, concordant with reduced transcript levels. similar_papers.title: Selective gene-expression profiling of migratory tumor cells in vivo predicts clinical outcome in breast cancer patients
differences: 聚焦于在体肿瘤内原位分离高迁移亚群并进行转录组刻画，策略偏向标志物发现与临床预后关联，缺乏针对候选基因的直接功能性干预验证描述。
similar_papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Metastasis of breast cancer is the main cause of death in patients. Previous genome-wide studies have identified gene-expression patterns correlated with cancer patient outcome. However, these were derived mostly from whole tissue without respect to cell heterogeneity. In reality, only a small subpopulation of invasive cells inside the primary tumor is responsible for escaping and initiating dissemination and metastasis. When whole tissue is used for molecular profiling, the expression pattern of these cells is masked by the majority of the noninvasive tumor cells. Therefore, little information is available about the crucial early steps of the metastatic cascade: migration, invasion, and entry of tumor cells into the systemic circulation. similar_papers.title: Tumor Spheroid-Based Migration Assays for Evaluation of Therapeutic Agents
differences: 构建3D肿瘤球迁移模型以还原微环境异质性，核心应用指向抗迁移药物评价，摘要未阐明如何将特定候选基因递送并与迁移表型定量挂钩。
similar_papers.abstract: Cell migration is a key hallmark of malignant cells that contributes to the progression of cancers from a primary, localized mass to an invasive and/or metastatic phenotype. Traditional methods for the evaluation of tumor cell migration in vitro generally employ two-dimensional (2D), homogeneous cultures that do not take into account tumor heterogeneity, three-dimensional (3D) cell-cell contacts between tumor and/or host cells or interactions with extracellular matrix proteins. Here we describe a 3D tumor spheroid-based migration assay which more accurately reflects the solid tumor microenvironment and can accommodate both extracellular matrix and host cell interactions. It is a rapid and highly reproducible 96-well plate-based technique and we demonstrate its utility for the evaluation of therapeutic agents/drugs with anti-migratory properties.

similar_papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cell migration is a highly complex process, regulated by multiple genes, signaling pathways and external stimuli. To discover genes or pharmacological agents that can modulate the migratory activity of cells, screening strategies that enable the monitoring of diverse migratory parameters in a large number of samples are necessary. METHODOLOGY: In the present study, we describe the development of a quantitative, high-throughput cell migration assay, based on a modified phagokinetic tracks (PKT) procedure, and apply it for identifying novel pro-migratory genes in a cancer-related gene library. In brief, cells are seeded on fibronectin-coated 96-well plates, covered with a monolayer of carboxylated latex beads. similar_papers.title: Quantifying the invasion and migration ability of cancer cells with a 3D Matrigel drop invasion assay
differences: 明确列出该方法可用于测试候选基因在侵袭/迁移中的功能角色，并支持蛋白定位原位分析；差异在于摘要未涵盖验证后的体内转移模型补充或机制互作实验。
similar_papers.abstract: Metastasis is the main cause of cancer-associated morbidity which will account for ∼ 600,000 deaths in the USA in 2021. Defining new mechanisms that drive cancer metastasis is vital for developing new therapeutic strategies and improving clinical outcomes for cancer patients. Herein, we describe a recently established 3D Matrigel drop invasion assay to measure cancer cell invasion and migration capability in vitro. This assay is a versatile and simple tool to test the ability of cells to invade and migrate, test the functional role of genes of interest in cell invasion and migration, analyze the localization of the target proteins at the cell invasion edge in situ, and screen drug effects on cancer cell invasion and migration.

similar_papers.abstract: Cell migration plays a major role in a variety of biological processes and a detailed understanding of associated mechanisms should lead to advances in the medical sciences, for example, in drug discovery for cancer therapy. However, the traditional methods used for analysis of cell migration cannot easily be scaled up for high-throughput screening. In this study, we have attempted to develop a novel simple method for high-throughput phenotypic screening for the identification of genes that are required for cell migration. As the appropriate cell line for the method, we found NBT-L2b cells that would be suitable for screening of migration-related genes in our method without influence by other cellular processes. differences: MigExpress平台通过比对快/慢迁移细胞的转录组与蛋白质组差异来关联迁移能力，属于观察性/相关性分析策略；不同于直接的功能获得/丧失实验，摘要未涉及表型验证后的因果性确认步骤。
similar_papers.abstract: Cell migration is an essential process in health and in disease, including cancer metastasis. A comprehensive inventory of migration factors is nonetheless lacking-in part due to the difficulty in assessing migration using high-throughput technologies. Hence, there are currently very few screens that systematically reveal factors controlling cell migration. Here, we introduce MigExpress as a platform for the 'identification of Migration control genes by differential Expression'. MigExpress exploits the combination of in-depth molecular profiling and the robust quantitative analysis of migration capacity in a broad panel of samples and identifies migration-associated genes by their differential expression in slow- versus fast-migrating cells. differences: 检索资料主要提供各类高通量筛选平台（siRNA文库、PKT轨道法、芯片微阵列）及3D体外模型（肿瘤球、Matrigel），整体侧重方法学建立与表型定量统计。
摘要层面缺乏完整的验证闭环描述，未系统涵盖体外功能敲低/过表达结合Rescue实验、多代系稳定株构建及活体远处转移监测等进阶验证环节。
部分研究偏向相关性组学挖掘或药物评价导向，与针对单一候选基因进行严谨因果性验证的标准化流程存在视角差异。
novel_angles: 从二维平面划痕转向三维微环境模拟（肿瘤球/基质胶柱），以更贴近生理状态下细胞-基质相互作用对迁移的约束与诱导。
利用空间异质性富集策略（如在体原位捕获活跃迁移前沿细胞群）先行纯化高迁移亚群，再进行候选基因扰动，降低背景噪音。
引入自动化多参数形态测量与单细胞轨迹追踪算法，替代人工计数，提升迁移速率、持久性与方向性的定量分辨率。
采用“表型分选-组学关联-反向功能验证”的迭代逻辑，先通过速度差异锁定差异表达分子，再回归经典干扰实验确认必要性。

design.goal: 如何验证候选基因对肿瘤细胞迁移的影响？
design.change_summary: 初稿。基于提供的文献背景（Hippo信号通路、YAP/TEAD4在结直肠癌及纤维化中的作用），设计体外细胞实验以评估候选基因对细胞迁移功能的影响。未指定具体候选基因，故以通用“候选基因”指代；模型选择基于文献中提及的结直肠癌背景，但需待验证适用性。
constraints: 不编造具体细胞系名称，除非作为示例并标注待确定

nodes.label: 模型建立与表达验证
nodes.detail: 构建候选基因过表达或敲低/敲除的肿瘤细胞模型，并验证操作效率。鉴于research_context中提到YAP/TEAD4在结直肠癌中的作用，初步考虑使用结癌细胞系，但具体型号需根据候选基因的特异性确定。

steps.name: 载体构建与转染/感染
steps.purpose: 实现候选基因的表达调控
steps.method: 设计针对候选基因的慢病毒载体（过表达或shRNA/siRNA）。若文献支持，优先选择具有上皮-间质转化（EMT）特征的肿瘤细胞系。
steps.controls: 空载体对照（Empty Vector）、非靶向scramble shRNA/siRNA对照、未处理对照组。
steps.readouts: mRNA和蛋白水平的表达变化（qPCR, Western Blot），待确定最佳转染条件。

steps.name: 细胞活力与毒性检测
steps.purpose: 排除因细胞死亡导致的迁移能力假性降低
steps.method: CCK-8或MTS法检测不同时间点细胞增殖情况。
steps.readouts: 细胞存活率曲线，待确定安全有效的药物/基因作用浓度或MOI。

nodes.label: 细胞迁移功能评估
nodes.detail: 通过两种经典的体外迁移实验评估候选基因对肿瘤细胞物理移动能力的影响。

steps.name: Transwell小室迁移实验
steps.purpose: 评估细胞的趋化迁移能力
steps.method: 在无基质胶的Transwell小室下层加入含血清的培养基作为趋化因子，上层接种经基因修饰的细胞。培养一定时间后，固定并染色迁移至底部的细胞。
steps.readouts: 显微镜下计数迁移细胞数量，计算迁移率。统计方法待预实验确定。

steps.name: 划痕愈合实验（Wound Healing Assay）
steps.purpose: 评估细胞的群体迁移和自我修复能力
steps.method: 在培养板中用枪头制造线性划痕，PBS清洗后更换无血清培养基，定时拍摄划痕宽度图像。
steps.readouts: 划痕闭合率随时间的变化曲线。需确保细胞密度一致。

nodes.label: 机制初探（可选，视N2结果而定）
nodes.detail: 若N2显示显著影响，结合context中提到的Hippo/YAP通路，探索是否通过相关下游分子起作用。

steps.name: 关键通路蛋白检测
steps.purpose: 验证候选基因是否影响已知的迁移相关信号通路（如YAP核定位、VEGF等）
steps.method: Western Blot检测总蛋白及磷酸化蛋白水平；免疫荧光观察YAP/TEAD等转录共激活因子的亚细胞分布。
steps.controls: 阳性对照（已知调节该通路的药物或基因，待确定）。
steps.readouts: 蛋白条带灰度值分析，荧光强度定量。具体靶点待根据候选基因同源性及文献推测确定。

assumptions: 候选基因确实能在所选肿瘤细胞系中有效表达或沉默
迁移能力的改变不是由细胞周期阻滞或毒性引起的
所选细胞系具备活跃的迁移潜能（如可能处于EMT状态）
